configuration.form: targeted (the one-step form is fitted beside it on the known-mechanism cells)
configuration.reduced_outcome_learner: unpenalized logistic (least squares for a stochastic-regime key) on a polynomial of logit(g), degree per law, capped at the number of distinct values minus one
configuration.folds: the package's random partition, random_state from the replication seed

pre_routed.bias/ey0__flexible: law P is H1, so the validity term vanishes for this learner; the gradient-boosting learner's rate is not shown, so a red cell reads as the first or third C3 term
pre_routed.bias/ey1__flexible: law P is H1, so the validity term vanishes for this learner; the gradient-boosting learner's rate is not shown, so a red cell reads as the first or third C3 term
pre_routed.bias/ate__flexible: law P is H1, so the validity term vanishes for this learner; the gradient-boosting learner's rate is not shown, so a red cell reads as the first or third C3 term
pre_routed.spread/parametric_q_ne_qr: the Theorem 1 curve is conservative under a fitted parametric mechanism when Q_0 != Qr_0 (the projection of 1.2); this is why AdaptiveIPTW withholds the interval

red_reading.primary: a red primary row blocks the merge and gets a diagnosis
red_reading.calibration: a red calibration row is a finite-sample red only when the 99% interval of its SE ratio contains 1, its coverage interval contains 0.95 or lies inside [0.92, 0.98], and the diagnosis finds no defect; it then goes to reporting with an owner
red_reading.bias: a red positive bias row is a finite-sample red only when the 99% interval of its standardized bias contains the design-predicted b, the other rows of its scene are consistent with their own b, and the diagnosis finds no defect; it then goes to reporting with an owner
red_reading.ladder: a red root_n_points rung or root_n_rate slope reads as a bias row does: finite-sample only when its interval contains the predicted b of the rung
red_reading.necessity: a targeted positive row reads as a bias row; a red displacement, or an untargeted control that does not fail, is a defect suspect and never a finite-sample red
red_reading.control: a control that does not fail is a defect suspect in the instrument, never a finite-sample red
